findings.evidence: `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/RepresentationTheory/SchurWeyl/Suggested.lean:213` pins `schurPoly (σ : Type*) ... {n} (μ : n.Partition)`, and README lines 318–320 likewise define the finite alphabet as arbitrary `σ`, with `Fin d` only an equivalent specialization; the PR declaration at line 190 exposes only `schurPoly N R μ` for `μ : YoungDiagram`.
findings.fix: Refactor the public definition to `schurPoly (σ : Type*) (R : Type*) [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [CommSemiring R] {n} (μ : n.Partition) : MvPolynomial σ R`, using the `Fin`/diagram construction only as an internal implementation or specialization.
findings.issue: `schurPoly` is restricted to variables `Fin N` and a `YoungDiagram`, while the owning roadmap specifies an arbitrary finite variable type and partition indexing; downstream symmetric-function results therefore cannot use the promised canonical API.

summary: The public Schur-polynomial API is under-generalized relative to its natural and roadmap-specified form.
